AI has dramatically expanded who can build software inside Aiven. You'll own the engineering system for Aiven's internal applications: one foundation that makes building at this scale safe, maintainable and efficient, so applications are easy to maintain, merge and split as the business changes.

You'll prove it on real products. Then you'll help teams across the company move onto it.

You'll build on Aiven Runtime, our own product, as its demanding internal customer. What you learn running real applications on it goes back to the product teams.

As a Staff engineer, your impact is mostly outside your own team, and your leverage comes through influence rather than authority.

You'll join a small team responsible for the data, systems and internal software behind how Aiven operates, based at our Helsinki HQ. We work together in the office three days a week.

Within two months, you've got the first applications running in production on Aiven Runtime. Within six months, you've shipped the improvements our hiring platform and gateway need most and built what you learned into the shared layer, most of our actively developed applications run on the shared layer, and people across the business ship on it without waiting for you. If you're excited about applying machine learning to customer support, document verification, and fraud detection challenges across Bolt's 200M+ customers, you'll find plenty of impactful work here.

With over 200 million customers across 50+ countries and 850+ cities, Bolt is one of the fastest-growing tech companies in Europe and Africa — powered by 4.5+ million partners on our platform, 4,000+ employees globally. And it's all thanks to our people.

We believe in creating an inclusive environment where everyone is welcome, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, or ability.

Our ultimate goal is to make cities for people, not cars — and we need your help on this mission!

### About the role

The Product team shapes the experiences that power Revolut. They turn complex problems into simple, scalable solutions, collaborating across Design, Engineering, and Data to build features our customers love.

We’re looking for an Applied AI Engineer who can manage their product roadmap, including day-to-day operations, project execution, and risk assessment.

From conception to launch and beyond, you’ll collaborate cross-functionally and communicate with senior management to be the go-to person for your product.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

### What you'll be doing

* Owning the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI-powered solutions, leveraging LLMs and other machine learning technologies
* Collaborating closely with Data Scientists and Software Engineers to deliver impactful solutions
* Leading cross-functional teams to build and deploy NLP and AI solutions, such as AI assistants and AI automation platforms
* Setting your team's goals, success metrics, and roadmap to align with company goals
* Delivering measurable results for sophisticated products under ambiguous situations in a fast-paced environment

### What you'll need

* Experience developing and launching AI products/features from scratch
* High analytical and technical acumen, along with solid business sense and problem-solving skills
* Experience in a data science or machine learning role
* Experience owning machine learning projects, from design to implementation and iteration
* Great Python, SQL, or other programming language skills
* Hands-on experience with deep learning libs (TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, etc.)
* Knowledge of version control, model deployment, and developer environments
* Evidence of impressive mathematical and statistical knowledge
* An entrepreneurial drive to never settle
